# Auto-Generated Empirical Resume Bullets (Verified from `results/uci/`)

- Built an end-to-end demand-forecasting and labor-scheduling pipeline in Python and DuckDB SQL over 1,067,371 UCI Online Retail II records (992,034 deduplicated order-line picks across 105 weeks), cutting sealed-test WAPE to 19.56% (vs. 21.02% same-weekday baseline; 22.42% vs. 32.65% on rolling validation) via leakage-free rolling Ridge regression.
- Formulated a 5-day mixed-integer linear program (Pyomo, HiGHS) allocating 40 weekly flex hours across indivisible 4-hour blocks under training-calibrated peak capacity (C=2,068, q=443), reducing modeled backlog objective cost by 17.25% (18.02% with unsmoothed lags; 10/12 test weeks won) vs. flat staffing across 4 capacity regimes, a 9-scenario sensitivity grid, and a 381-schedule brute-force optimality check.
